acceptanceCriteria: Resolved with a regression test using a committed Latin-1 path, or closed by an owner decision that the current behavior stands.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 as a gap left open by decision 0394, which accepted IDX-SNAP-V0-024 (panel blocker B9, PR #219): a tracked path whose Git bytes are not UTF-8 is an index exclusion, not a repository refusal. The context packet has no exclusions member for any reason, so a non-UTF-8 path excluded from the index is disclosed only in the impact and prove receipts. An agent using context alone cannot see the gap (AGENTS.md invariant 2). A fix adds a bounded exclusion disclosure to the task-context packet under a spec amendment, or an owner decision records that impact and prove disclosure is enough.
title: B9 gap: the context packet does not disclose non-UTF-8 path exclusions
